mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM payment_operation p JOIN payment_authorization a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.business_type='EXPENSE' AND a.business_id=#{id} AND a.application_id=#{applicationId} AND a.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT id,business_type,business_id,application_id,round_no FROM voucher_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status<>'POSTED' ORDER BY id

SELECT p.id,a.business_type,a.business_id,a.application_id,a.round_no FROM payment_operation p JOIN payment_authorization a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.status<>'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY p.id
